highlights: Photos are now kept on your phone between visits instead of being re-downloaded every time you open the app cold. Measured with it on: a second visit went from 24 requests / 3,341 KB to zero.
The cache stores thumbnails only and clears out any full-size originals it had saved before, so it stays bounded — the 500-item ceiling is about 115 MB rather than the ~2 GB it could have been.
